assessments.name: In-class test
assessments.description: This test will consist of a passage followed by various comprehension activities of different formats, some exercises of grammar and vocabulary, and a short writing task.

assessments.name: Listening test
assessments.description: This test consists of an audio and questions in different formats to be answered (in Italian).
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Reading & Writing test
assessments.description: This test will consist of one reading passage with comprehension activities in different formats, all in Italian; and one short written composition in Italian.

assessments.name: Speaking test
assessments.description:
The Speaking Test will be a conversation between the student and the tutor. 
It will be based on the topics studied during the Semester. 
Practice questions will be provided beforehand. 
More detailed information about the test will be posted in Canvas.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Grammar test
assessments.description: This test consists of a series of grammar exercises of different formats, based on grammatical structures and vocabulary studied throughout the semester.
